sentences.en: Suicide rates have been steadily increasing in recent years, according to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention.
sentences.zh: 根据美国疾病控制与预防中心的数据，近年来自杀率一直在稳步上升。

sentences.en: Still, stigma and lack of access to mental health services prevent many people from receiving the help they need.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，社会污名和心理健康服务获取渠道的匮乏，仍使许多人无法得到他们所需的帮助。

sentences.en: In this episode,
sentences.zh: 在本期节目中，

sentences.en: psychologist and professor Nadine Kaslau talks about what psychologists are doing to enhance the services available to people who are struggling with thoughts of suicide.
sentences.zh: 心理学家兼教授 Nadine Kaslau 将探讨心理学家们正在采取哪些措施，以改善那些正与自杀念头作斗争的人群所能获得的服务。

sentences.en: I'm Audrey Hamilton, and this is Speaking of Psychology.
sentences.zh: 我是 Audrey Hamilton，这里是《心理学谈话》。

sentences.en: We're speaking with Dr. Nadine Kaslau, 2014 President of the American Psychological Association.
sentences.zh: 我们今天采访的对象是 2014 年美国心理学会主席 Nadine Kaslau 博士。

sentences.en: A tenured professor at Emory University's School of Medicine, Dr. Kaslau is also a practicing clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: Kaslau 博士是埃默里大学医学院的终身教授，同时也是一位执业临床心理学家。

sentences.en: She is here to talk with us today about suicide prevention and how psychologists are developing new and innovative ways to help those who are suffering.
sentences.zh: 她今天来到这里，与我们探讨自杀预防，以及心理学家如何开发创新方法来帮助那些受苦的人们。

sentences.en: Thank you for joining us, Dr. Kaslau.
sentences.zh: 感谢您参加我们的节目，Kaslau 博士。

sentences.en: I'm delighted to be here.
sentences.zh: 很高兴能来到这里。

sentences.en: Suicide prevention is an issue you feel very strongly about, and it has been a focus of your work throughout your career.
sentences.zh: 自杀预防是您非常关注的一个议题，也是您整个职业生涯的工作重点。

sentences.en: Tell us why you have chosen to spend your time helping those who feel they have nowhere else to turn.
sentences.zh: 请告诉我们，为什么您选择将时间投入到帮助那些感到走投无路的人身上？

sentences.en: I think my interest in suicide and preventing suicide began when I was in high school, and one of my closest friend's mothers died by suicide.
sentences.zh: 我想我对自杀及预防自杀的兴趣始于高中时期，当时我最亲密的朋友之一，她的母亲自杀身亡了。

sentences.en: And I saw the profound impact that this had on her children, her husband, and the community at large, and the pain and suffering that everyone else experienced.
sentences.zh: 我亲眼目睹了这件事对她的孩子、丈夫以及整个社区造成的深远影响，也看到了每个人所经历的痛苦与折磨。

sentences.en: And I believe it was then that I wanted to do something about it.
sentences.zh: 我想，正是从那时起，我立志要为此做点什么。

sentences.en: Then when I became, well, when I was in graduate school, actually, at the end of my postdoc,
sentences.zh: 后来，当我进入研究生院，准确地说是博士后研究快结束时，

sentences.en: a patient of mine who I was extremely attached to died by suicide, and it was very, very difficult for me.
sentences.zh: 我的一位非常亲近的病人自杀身亡了，这对我的打击非常、非常大。

sentences.en: It was extremely difficult for me personally as well as professionally.
sentences.zh: 无论是在个人层面还是专业层面，这对我来说都极其艰难。

sentences.en: I realized, however, that she chose to die by suicide because she was in so much pain in her life.
sentences.zh: 然而我意识到，她选择自杀是因为她在生活中承受了太多的痛苦。

sentences.en: She was in such psychic pain, and she was hearing voices and having visual hallucinations as well.
sentences.zh: 她承受着巨大的心理痛苦，同时还伴有幻听和幻视。

sentences.en: And she was tormented and tortured and profoundly depressed, and she couldn't tolerate living anymore.
sentences.zh: 她备受折磨，深陷抑郁，再也无法忍受活下去。

sentences.en: And so I really wanted to, after that, help people both who were in so much pain try to reduce their pain in other ways,
sentences.zh: 在那之后，我真心希望能帮助那些承受巨大痛苦的人，尝试以其他方式减轻他们的痛苦，

sentences.en: as well as help families and friends and community cope after someone died by suicide.
sentences.zh: 同时也帮助那些在亲友自杀后需要应对悲痛的家庭、朋友和社区。

sentences.en: What are psychologists doing to enhance the services available to people who are struggling with thoughts of suicide?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们正在采取哪些措施来改善那些正与自杀念头作斗争的人群所能获得的服务？

sentences.en: I understand there's an app you and your team have developed called Relief Link.
sentences.zh: 据我了解，您和您的团队开发了一款名为 Relief Link 的应用程序。

sentences.en: Can you tell us about that as well?
sentences.zh: 您能跟我们介绍一下吗？

sentences.en: Let me talk a little bit about what psychologists are doing.
sentences.zh: 让我先谈谈心理学家们正在做的一些工作。

sentences.en: Increasingly, psychologists are developing evidence-based treatments for suicidal persons, people with suicidal ideation or suicide attempts,
sentences.zh: 心理学家们正越来越多地为有自杀倾向的人，即有自杀意念或有过自杀企图的人，开发循证治疗方法，

sentences.en: and developing evidence-based treatments for youth, for adults, and for older adults, as well as for individuals from different ethnic racial groups.
sentences.zh: 并为青少年、成年人、老年人以及不同种族和族裔群体开发循证治疗方案。

sentences.en: So that's one thing psychologists are doing.
sentences.zh: 这是心理学家们正在做的一方面工作。

sentences.en: The second thing that many psychologists are involved with are the Garrett Lee Smith grants.
sentences.zh: 第二点是许多心理学家参与了“Garrett Lee Smith”拨款项目。

sentences.en: And these grants are given to colleges and universities and tribal communities, as well as to states, to develop major suicide prevention efforts.
sentences.zh: 这些拨款旨在资助高校、部落社区以及各州，以开展重大的自杀预防工作。

sentences.en: And I believe that these grants have really helped facilitate infrastructures in different settings
sentences.zh: 我相信这些拨款确实有助于在不同环境中建立基础设施，

sentences.en: and have really made a difference, and psychologists are often leaders on these grants.
sentences.zh: 并真正产生了影响，而心理学家往往是这些项目的领导者。

sentences.en: In terms of developing apps that can be useful adjuncts or used as a primary tool for individuals who are suicidal,
sentences.zh: 在开发可作为辅助手段，或作为有自杀倾向者主要工具的应用程序方面，

sentences.en: the Substance Abuse and Mental Health Services Administration, SAMHSA, put out an app challenge last year and asked for people to submit apps related to suicide prevention.
sentences.zh: 美国药物滥用和心理健康服务管理局（SAMHSA）去年发起了一项应用挑战赛，征集与自杀预防相关的应用程序。

sentences.en: We were extremely fortunate that our app was the winner of the First Place Prize.
sentences.zh: 我们非常幸运，我们的应用程序获得了第一名。

sentences.en: And the app helps talk to people or connect people with services, has safety planning on there, has various activities that people can do when they're feeling suicidal,
sentences.zh: 该应用程序可以帮助人们沟通或连接服务资源，提供安全计划，并包含各种人们在感到有自杀倾向时可以进行的活动，

sentences.en: and allows people to develop very individualized plans, as well as get help anywhere they are in the United States.
sentences.zh: 它允许人们制定高度个性化的计划，并能在美国任何地方获得帮助。

sentences.en: How can digital technology work in conjunction with one-on-one therapy?
sentences.zh: 数字技术如何与一对一的心理治疗相结合？

sentences.en: Has there been research in this area?
sentences.zh: 这一领域是否有相关研究？

sentences.en: There's growing research on digital technology, and there's media-related interventions right now, and these are growing, especially for people with medical difficulties.
sentences.zh: 关于数字技术的研究正在增加，目前也有相关的媒体干预措施，这些都在增长，特别是在针对有医疗困难的人群方面。

sentences.en: But it is very clear that people in the younger generations really turn to the media, to social media, as a way to get all sorts of assistance.
sentences.zh: 但很明显，年轻一代确实转向媒体，特别是社交媒体，作为获取各种援助的途径。

sentences.en: I really think it's important for therapists to encourage people who might be interested to download apps on their smartphones or on their tablets,
sentences.zh: 我真心认为，治疗师鼓励有兴趣的患者在智能手机或平板电脑上下载应用程序非常重要，

sentences.en: and to use them as they see fit in a way that integrates them with the treatment.
sentences.zh: 并让他们以适合自己的方式使用这些应用，将其融入到治疗过程中。

sentences.en: Sometimes, for example, you might encourage a patient or a client to use these apps to rate their mood daily
sentences.zh: 例如，有时你可以鼓励患者或客户使用这些应用程序来记录每日情绪，

sentences.en: or their suicidal ideation daily and agree with them that if it gets above a certain level, here's what the safety plan would be.
sentences.zh: 或者记录每日的自杀意念，并与他们约定，如果指标超过一定水平，安全计划该如何执行。

sentences.en: And here's when you might contact your therapist, here's when you might need to call 911 or go to the emergency room.
sentences.zh: 以及何时该联系治疗师，何时需要拨打 911 或前往急诊室。

sentences.en: So I think they can be integrated in very creative ways.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为它们可以以非常有创意的方式整合起来。

sentences.en: I also think that a lot of adolescents and young adults can teach us ways to effectively integrate them, especially how to communicate with them via these tools.
sentences.zh: 我也认为许多青少年和年轻人可以教我们如何有效地整合这些工具，特别是如何通过这些工具与他们沟通。

sentences.en: I believe that psychology and psychologists have begun to very seriously consider how to integrate social media and other forms of technology into their work.
sentences.zh: 我相信心理学界和心理学家们已经开始非常认真地考虑如何将社交媒体和其他形式的技术融入到工作中。

sentences.en: But I also think that we have a number of other steps that we need to consider
sentences.zh: 但我也认为，我们还有许多其他步骤需要考虑，

sentences.en: before we have a really good plan for doing this in a very effective way.
sentences.zh: 才能制定出一套真正有效实施这一计划的方案。

sentences.en: You mentioned young people, and they are very focused on social media and digital technology.
sentences.zh: 您提到了年轻人，他们非常关注社交媒体和数字技术。

sentences.en: There have been some high-profile cases in the media where a young person has committed suicide after being cyberbullied or harassed online.
sentences.zh: 媒体上曾报道过一些备受关注的案例，年轻人因遭受网络欺凌或骚扰而自杀。

sentences.en: Is suicide increasing among young people?
sentences.zh: 年轻人的自杀率在上升吗？

sentences.en: How do we direct prevention efforts toward these youth?
sentences.zh: 我们该如何针对这些青少年开展预防工作？

sentences.en: So there's some suggestion that suicide rates are increasing among certain subgroups of young people.
sentences.zh: 有一些迹象表明，特定青少年群体的自杀率正在上升。

sentences.en: I also think that we're hearing more and more about suicides of young people, and so sometimes it's a little difficult to tell what's an actual increase
sentences.zh: 我也认为我们越来越多地听到关于年轻人自杀的消息，所以有时很难分辨这到底是实际增长，

sentences.en: versus what's better reporting and surveillance.
sentences.zh: 还是因为报告和监测机制的完善。

sentences.en: But there are definitely concerns that young people are very effective by what goes on via social media,
sentences.zh: 但可以肯定的是，人们非常担心年轻人受到社交媒体上发生的事情的影响，

sentences.en: and things like cyberbullying have clearly been associated with some young people's death by suicide.
sentences.zh: 像网络欺凌这类事情显然与一些年轻人的自杀身亡有关。

sentences.en: It's tricky to direct prevention efforts to this, but I think we need activities in the schools and programs in the schools related to this
sentences.zh: 针对这一点开展预防工作很棘手，但我认为我们需要在学校开展相关活动和项目，

sentences.en: and related to talking about things like cyberbullying and cyberharassment and the link between that and suicidal thoughts and actions, as well as aggressive thoughts and actions.
sentences.zh: 讨论网络欺凌、网络骚扰，以及它们与自杀念头和行为，还有攻击性思想和行为之间的联系。

sentences.en: So school-based programming is important.
sentences.zh: 因此，基于学校的项目非常重要。

sentences.en: I also think such programming needs to exist in other places in the community,
sentences.zh: 我也认为此类项目需要在社区的其他场所开展，

sentences.en: whether those be religious organizations or other places that young people go for community activities.
sentences.zh: 无论是宗教组织还是年轻人参与社区活动的其他地方。

sentences.en: In addition, the media can be extremely helpful to us here in terms of talking about this,
sentences.zh: 此外，媒体在这方面可以为我们提供极大的帮助，不仅是报道此事，

sentences.en: but also blogging about this, having programs that talk about this on channels that kids listen to.
sentences.zh: 还可以通过撰写博客，以及在孩子们收听的频道上制作讨论此类话题的节目。

sentences.en: So I think there's a number of different ways we can engage more actively in preventive efforts.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为我们可以通过多种不同的方式更积极地参与预防工作。

sentences.en: Also, I think that parents and schools and other settings need to take things like cyberbullying very, very seriously because it has extremely negative effects on young people.
sentences.zh: 同时，我认为家长、学校和其他机构需要非常、非常认真地对待网络欺凌，因为它对年轻人有极大的负面影响。

sentences.en: What are the barriers to getting care for suicidal youth and their families?
sentences.zh: 青少年及其家庭在寻求心理护理方面存在哪些障碍？

sentences.en: One of the first barriers is the stigma about getting psychological services.
sentences.zh: 首要障碍之一是关于接受心理服务的社会污名。

sentences.en: Many people in many communities would rather do anything else than get psychological services because they're worried about the stigma associated with that.
sentences.zh: 在许多社区，很多人宁愿做任何其他事情也不愿接受心理服务，因为他们担心随之而来的污名化。

sentences.en: So they don't want to see the school counselor or the school psychologist because they don't want the other kids to know that there's something wrong with them
sentences.zh: 所以他们不想见学校辅导员或学校心理学家，因为他们不想让其他孩子知道自己出了问题，

sentences.en: and they feel like they're going to be labeled.
sentences.zh: 而且他们觉得会被贴上标签。

sentences.en: So stigma is one major barrier.
sentences.zh: 所以污名化是一个主要障碍。

sentences.en: The second major barrier is that there are not a sufficient number of psychologists
sentences.zh: 第二个主要障碍是，心理学家和其他心理健康专业人员的数量不足，

sentences.en: and other mental health professionals who are really comfortable with working with people who are suicidal, especially those who are extremely suicidal.
sentences.zh: 且真正能够从容应对自杀倾向人群，特别是那些有严重自杀倾向的人的专业人员还不够多。

sentences.en: So I think we need more training to help improve therapists' ability to effectively work with young people and others who are suicidal.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为我们需要更多的培训，以帮助提高治疗师有效帮助青少年及其他有自杀倾向人群的能力。

sentences.en: I think the third issue is that we don't have enough evidence-based services that we have available to us to offer for suicidal people, and we need to develop more of these.
sentences.zh: 我认为第三个问题是，我们没有足够的循证服务提供给有自杀倾向的人，我们需要开发更多此类服务。

sentences.en: What about suicide prevention in minority populations?
sentences.zh: 少数族裔群体的自杀预防工作情况如何？

sentences.en: Why does this deserve special attention, in your opinion?
sentences.zh: 在您看来，为什么这值得特别关注？

sentences.en: So I've devoted the last 20 years of my career to suicide prevention in the African-American community.
sentences.zh: 我职业生涯的最后 20 年都致力于非裔美国人社区的自杀预防工作。

sentences.en: Although rates of suicide are lower in the African-American community than in other communities,
sentences.zh: 尽管非裔美国人社区的自杀率低于其他社区，

sentences.en: there are different challenges and different issues that need to be attended to.
sentences.zh: 但仍存在需要关注的不同挑战和问题。

sentences.en: And so I think it's critical that we develop services that are culturally informed, that are culturally competent as well,
sentences.zh: 因此，我认为开发具有文化知情和文化胜任力的服务至关重要，

sentences.en: because we need to have services that really speak to people.
sentences.zh: 因为我们需要提供真正能与人们产生共鸣的服务。

sentences.en: So we need to know, for example, in some communities, like the Native American community, there's often very high rates of substance abuse linked to suicidal behavior.
sentences.zh: 我们需要了解，例如在一些社区，如美洲原住民社区，通常存在与自杀行为相关的高比例药物滥用问题。

sentences.en: And so their programming really needs to target those linkages.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们的项目确实需要针对这些关联因素。

sentences.en: And we know that it's critically important that those programs be done in a way that's very attuned to the cultural issues and the communal nature of their communities.
sentences.zh: 我们知道，以非常契合其文化议题和社区集体性质的方式开展这些项目至关重要。

sentences.en: And so I think that people from different races and ethnic backgrounds, people from different sexual orientations, genders, et cetera, ages,
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，来自不同种族和族裔背景、不同性取向、性别、年龄的人群，

sentences.en: all need treatments that are very, very tailored to them.
sentences.zh: 都需要量身定制的治疗方案。

sentences.en: I don't think it's a one-size-fits-all opportunity.
sentences.zh: 我不认为有一种“万能”的解决方案。

sentences.en: Thank you so much, Dr. Caslow, for joining us.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢您参加我们的节目，Kaslau 博士。

sentences.en: You're most welcome.
sentences.zh: 不客气。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: For more information on suicide prevention and Dr. Caslow, visit our website at speakingofpsychology.org.
sentences.zh: 如需了解更多关于自杀预防和 Kaslau 博士的信息，请访问我们的网站 speakingofpsychology.org。

sentences.en: With the American Psychological Association's Speaking of Psychology, I'm Audrey Hamilton.
sentences.zh: 这里是美国心理学会的《心理学谈话》，我是 Audrey Hamilton。
